page.layout: One column of running text; in the left margin, marginal references beside the lines of the first paragraphs (Exod. 30. 16 and Rom. 5. 3). Running head at top; page number at top centre.

main_text.p: batur in opus Tabernaculi Ecclesiæ, eritque ipsi ad memoriam coram Domino, ad expiandam per sanguinem Christi animam ipsius. Quicquid enim hujusmodi anima Deo dicata, sibi aut aliis precata, deprecatave fuerit, propitias Dei aures habet, minimèque levis ex hujusmodi pro nobis apud Deum interpellatione fructus, ad salutem nos æternam enutriens prodit. Hinc tam sedulus fuit ipse Apostolus, vas illud electum, in eliciendis sibique colligendis præcibus sanctorum suorum discipulorum. Non loquar jam de charitate in liberos, quæ tanto bono ipsos privari ut patiatur, non decet: quum à Christo rege suo promissum acceperint, quod is qui mesfuerit mercedem Domini mercedem accepturus sit, & fructum permanentem, in vitam æternam collecturus: quumque nullus sit in hac vita tam lætus & felix, adeoque paratus ad res vel secundas vel adversas sine damno ferendas, quam qui divini Verbi præconium suscepit; qui consolatione sacræ scripturæ & conscientiæ puræ testimonio confirmatus, gratiæ divinæ innititur: quod ita se habere, Apostolus Gentium Paulus suo ipsius exemplo testatur; dicens se gloriari super ipsis etiam afflictionibus, quia sciret, quod afflictio

page.notes: Marginal references at left: "Exod. 30. 16." beside the first line; "Rom. 5. 3." beside the line "Apostolus Gentium Paulus". The last line is partly faded; "ipsis" and "afflictio" at the foot are read from a faint scan. Several words are uncertain and should be checked against the scan: "ipfos" (read as ipsos), "mesfuerit" (read as "meliùs" is not reliable; printed form appears as "mesfuerit"), "accepturus" and "innititur" are partly obscured by a heavy crease. Words that could not be read with certainty are marked [?] where they appear in the text above: "mercedem" was printed with a crowded line and is followed by a second partial word that is not clear. Show-through from the facing page is present and omitted. A catchword "fliction" does not appear as a separate word; the last word is printed on the line as "afflictio" and continues on the next page.
